text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"—On the last day of vacation, I watched a 
movie. It was a fine piece of cinema 
centered around family bonds."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
""I have compiled my thoughts and analysis 
of the movie into a document and attached 
it. I would appreciate it if you could 
read it in your spare time.""

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I opened the attached file from the email. 
A formal document appeared, and as I 
scrolled through reading it...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san. ...Could you 
perhaps be reviewing the attached 
documents?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I got a bit carried away while putting my 
thoughts to paper. I hesitated for a 
moment on whether I should actually send 
it, but...
choice_data_list:
I'm glad. I'm just happy you had a nice 
break.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
! Yes...! Both my body and soul feel 
rejuvenated. Fufu...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll reply to the essay comments later, 
but— it seems Air Messiah thoroughly 
rested her mind and body over the break.
